title: Curaçao Wins 2026 Little League World Series Championship
dek: Pariba Little League of Willemstad, Curaçao defeated Paseo Verde Little League of Henderson, Nevada 11-2 in the championship game. The victory marks Curaçao's second Little League World Series title in tournament history.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Curaçao won the 2026 Little League World Series championship, its second title ever, by defeating Paseo Verde Little League 11-2 after an offensive surge.
bottom_line: Curaçao now holds two Little League World Series crowns. The next question is whether this success reflects a sustained structural advantage in player development or a sequence of peak years.
body: Pariba Little League of Willemstad, Curaçao defeated Paseo Verde Little League of Henderson, Nevada 11-2 in the 2026 Little League World Series championship game, according to MLB.com reporting. The victory marks Curaçao's second championship in tournament history.

Curaçao overcame an early deficit with an offensive breakout to secure the title. The performance underscores the Caribbean nation's emerging footprint in youth baseball's most prominent international stage.
